title: A ternary switch model governing ERalpha ligand binding domain conformation.
authors: McDougal, Daniel P; Pederick, Jordan L; Novick, Scott J; Jovcevski, Blagojce; Warrender, Annmaree K; Pascal, Bruce D; Griffin, Patrick R; Bruning, John B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体结构与分子动力学模拟研究雌激素受体α配体结合域中螺旋12的三元构象开关机制，属于转录因子配体结合域构象动态的物理模拟研究，虽非直接DNA结合，但为TF变构调控机制提供可借鉴模型。
abstract: The transcription factor estrogen receptor alpha is the primary driver of ER+ breast cancer progression and a target of multiple FDA-approved anticancer drugs. Ligand-dependent activity of ERalpha is determined by helix-12 conformation within the ligand binding domain. However, how helix-12 transitions from an unliganded (apo) state to active (estrogen-bound) or inactive (SERM/SERD-bound) states remains unresolved. Here, we present the crystal structure of an apo estrogen receptor alpha ligand binding domain from the teleost Melanotaenia fluviatilis, revealing a third distinct helix-12 conformation. Structural mass spectrometry and molecular dynamics simulations reveal that apo helix-12 is maintained in a stable and distinct conformation prior to ligand binding. Clashes between ligand and evolutionarily conserved residues L525, L536 and L540 displace helix-12, to promote activation or inactivation of the receptor. The crystal structure further reveals that breast cancer-associated mutations, Y537S and D538G, disrupt residue contacts critical for stabilising apo helix-12 conformation. We propose a model whereby helix-12 functions as a ternary molecular switch to determine receptor activity. These findings provide critical insights into the ligand-dependent and -independent regulation of estrogen receptor alpha and have significant implications for therapeutic intervention.
abstract_zh: 转录因子雌激素受体α是ER+乳腺癌进展的主要驱动因素，也是多种FDA批准的抗癌药物的靶点。ERα的配体依赖性活性由配体结合域内的螺旋-12构象决定。然而，螺旋-12如何从非配体（apo）状态转变为活性（雌激素结合）或非活性（SERM/SERD结合）状态仍未解决。在此，我们展示了来自硬骨鱼Melanotaenia fluviatilis的apo雌激素受体α配体结合域的晶体结构，揭示了一种第三种独特的螺旋-12构象。结构质谱和分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟表明，apo螺旋-12在配体结合前保持稳定且独特的构象。配体与进化保守残基L525、L536和L540之间的冲突使螺旋-12发生位移，从而促进受体的激活或失活。晶体结构进一步揭示，乳腺癌相关突变Y537S和D538G破坏了稳定apo螺旋-12构象所必需的关键残基接触。我们提出一个模型，其中螺旋-12作为三元分子开关决定受体活性。这些发现为雌激素受体α的配体依赖性和非依赖性调控提供了关键见解，并对治疗干预具有重要意义。
